components.name: Primary button
components.description: Shared accent-filled action; theme variables remain live.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:36px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); border-radius:var(--ui-radius,6px); font:14px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-button:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; pointer-events:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }.ds-button { background:var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); border-color:var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); color:#111; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: Secondary action on a neutral surface.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:36px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); border-radius:var(--ui-radius,6px); font:14px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-button:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; pointer-events:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }.ds-button { background:var(--ui-surface,#18181b); color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: Quiet action with a pressed state.
components.css: .ds-button { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; min-height:36px; padding:8px 14px; border:1px solid var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); border-radius:var(--ui-radius,6px); font:14px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 120ms,border-color 120ms; } .ds-button:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-button:disabled { opacity:.4; pointer-events:none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition:none; } }.ds-button { background:transparent; border-color:transparent; color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); } .ds-button:hover, .ds-button[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--ui-muted,#27272a); border-color:var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); }

components.name: Library search
components.description: One wrapper boundary and full-opacity placeholder.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 5 5"/></svg><input type="search" aria-label="Search library" placeholder="Search" /></label>
components.css: .ds-search { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); border-radius:4px; background:var(--ui-muted,#27272a); color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); font:12px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-search input { width:100%; min-width:0; min-height:32px; padding:6px 0; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; color:inherit; font:inherit; outline:none; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color:var(--ui-text-muted,color-mix(in srgb,#fafafa 72%,#18181b)); opacity:1; } .ds-search:focus-within { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Settings tabs
components.description: Fixed tabs with a narrow selected underline; runtime adds roving focus and keyboard navigation.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; gap:6px; padding:0 26px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--ui-border,#ffffff26); font:14px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-tabs button { position:relative; min-height:46px; padding:0 14px; border:0; border-radius:var(--ui-radius,6px) var(--ui-radius,6px) 0 0; background:transparent; color:var(--ui-text-muted,#bdc2c7); font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--ui-muted,#27272a) 60%,transparent); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true] { color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]::after { content:""; position:absolute; left:10px; right:10px; bottom:-1px; height:2px; background:var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Dig presets
components.description: Muted preset chips invert when selected; runtime sets the real tagged-album filter.
components.css: .ds-presets { display:flex; gap:6px; overflow-x:auto; font:12px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-presets button { white-space:nowrap; min-height:32px; padding:6px 9px; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:var(--ui-muted,#27272a); color:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); font:inherit; cursor:pointer; } .ds-presets button[aria-pressed=true] { background:var(--ui-text,#fafafa); color:var(--ui-surface,#18181b); } .ds-presets button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-text,#fafafa); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-presets button:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-presets button { min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Cover card
components.description: Actual square fallback pattern; production cover images crop to this geometry.
components.css: .ds-cover { display:block; position:relative; width:200px; aspect-ratio:1; overflow:hidden; border:0; padding:0; border-radius:2px; background:#191919; color:#ddd; box-shadow:0 3px 6px #0004; cursor:pointer; } .ds-fallback { display:grid; place-items:center; height:100%; padding:16px; font:14px/1.4 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-cover:hover { outline:1px solid #fff; outline-offset:-1px; box-shadow:0 4px 18px #0009; } .ds-cover:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Cover transport
components.description: Separate Play/Pause/Resume control; confirmed listening and pending cancellation are runtime states.
components.html: <button class="ds-play" aria-label="Play album"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m8 5 11 7-11 7Z" /></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-play { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:36px; height:36px; min-height:36px; padding:0; border:0; border-radius:5px; background:#101010e6; color:#fff; cursor:pointer; } .ds-play:hover { filter:brightness(1.15); } .ds-play:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--play-accent,var(--ui-text,#fafafa)); outline-offset:3px; } @media (pointer:coarse) { .ds-play { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; } }

components.name: Preference slider
components.description: Visual geometry of the shared slider; actual pointer and keyboard semantics come from the shipped slider primitive.
components.css: .ds-slider { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; width:220px; min-width:80px; height:28px; touch-action:none; } .ds-track { display:block; width:100%; height:5px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:99px; background:#ffffff26; } .ds-range { display:block; width:50%; height:100%; background:var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); } .ds-thumb { position:absolute; left:calc(50% - 7.5px); width:15px; height:15px; padding:0; border:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); border-radius:50%; background:var(--ui-surface,#18181b); transition:transform 140ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background-color 120ms; } .ds-slider:hover .ds-thumb, .ds-thumb:focus-visible { transform:scale(1.18); } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-slider:active .ds-thumb { transform:scale(1.3); background:var(--ui-accent,#e4e4e7); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-thumb { transition:background-color 80ms; } .ds-slider:hover .ds-thumb, .ds-slider:active .ds-thumb, .ds-thumb:focus-visible { transform:none; } }

components.name: Dig mood map
components.description: Local gradient map for manual mood/energy tags; runtime supplies pointer capture and arrow/Home input.
components.css: .ds-map { display:block; position:relative; width:100%; height:190px; padding:0; border:0; background:linear-gradient(0deg,#164047a6,transparent),linear-gradient(90deg,#493351,#53512f); touch-action:none; cursor:crosshair; color:#fff; font:12px/1.5 var(--ui-font,"Avenir Next","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif); } .ds-axis { position:absolute; font-size:10px; pointer-events:none; } .ds-left { left:12px; top:calc(50% - 7px); } .ds-right { right:12px; top:calc(50% - 7px); } .ds-top { top:10px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); } .ds-bottom { bottom:10px; left:50%; transform:translateX(-50%); } .ds-cross { position:absolute; background:#ffffff30; pointer-events:none; } .ds-horizontal { left:15%; right:15%; height:1px; top:50%; } .ds-vertical { top:20%; bottom:20%; width:1px; left:50%; } .ds-point { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:12px; height:12px; border-radius:50%; background:#fff; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); box-shadow:0 2px 7px #0005; pointer-events:none; } .ds-map:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ui-text,#fafafa); outline-offset:3px; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-map { height:170px; } }

narrative.overview:
The approved direction is the Music Figma file's [Current page](https://www.figma.com/design/OfsKpzlMZkLzzoHMWA4FHg/Music?node-id=52-871): square cover artwork, a restrained charcoal ground, compact neutral controls, and direct playback. “Artwork leads” repeats the supplied direction; it is not a newly invented brand metaphor. Descriptive token names and the named rules below are documentation labels inferred from the implemented system.

This records the Svelte interface shared by web and Electron after the five scored implementation fixes received a ship disposition. Ground truth is `frontend/src/components.css`, `app.css`, `coss.css`, `Grid.svelte`, `ArtworkView.svelte`, `CollectionDetails.svelte`, `CollectionPlayback.svelte`, `Queue.svelte`, `Bar.svelte`, `DigPanel.svelte`, and the Settings implementation. Preserve the already polished tabbed Settings structure. Studio is the fresh-install component preset; saved Classic, Neon, Coss, materials, density, and motion preferences remain supported.

Album detail and Queue/Recently played share the full-color ArtworkView: equal desktop columns within (1680px), complete contained artwork bounded by viewport height, and a stacked phone cover up to (360px). Queue/history tabs remember their scroll positions. The bottom Menu toggles the expanded player and shows X while open; playback options remain in the header overflow menu anchored below its measured trigger. Share closes the expanded player before opening its drawer.

Evidence is the source plus the synthetic desktop and phone captures in `.impeccable/review/`, with scope and disposition in `.audit-results/figma-current/review-packet.md` and `finish-verdict.md`. No PRODUCT.md, QUALITY BAR card, approved comp, or comp-diff exists; this is an implementation record, not a pixel-match certification or a product requirements document. Physical touch, 60 fps performance, live Spotify/audio capture, delayed history-write execution, and native Mac rendering remain untested. The ship disposition covers the five scored fixes, not a complete surface certification. The subsequent unified album/player extension is recorded in `.audit-results/unified-player/review-packet.md`, with synthetic captures in `.impeccable/review/unified-player/`. That scope covers the shared artwork view, queue/history tabs, and relocated playback options; history timing under load and all-source queue mutation remain untested alongside the native, physical-touch, performance, and live-provider limits above.
keyCharacteristics: Square album artwork dominates the viewport.
Neutral chrome gives feedback through focused, hovered, selected, pending, and confirmed playback states.
Album detail and the expanded player adapt their ground to artwork while the playback bar stays neutral.
Background work preserves the user's wall order, view, scroll position, and queue.
Discovery states its manual-tag and listening-history data sources.

rules.name: The Artwork Ground Rule
rules.body: Keep the library control layer neutral; derive album-detail color from its artwork rather than treating fixture colors as brand colors.

rules.name: The Legible Control Rule
rules.body: Use the active theme's muted foreground for secondary control text and the library Search placeholder at opacity 1; a quiet control still needs visible text.

rules.name: The Stable Wall Rule
rules.body: Background refresh replaces tiles in place and appends new matches; only explicit filtering, sorting, or density actions may change the user's browsing arrangement. Apply warmed cover-color order through the explicit Apply action.

rules.name: The State Depth Rule
rules.body: Keep strong separation on floating surfaces and direct interaction states; do not add decorative elevation to every toolbar control.

rules.name: The Confirmed Playback Rule
rules.body: Show the thick white outline and listening bars only for confirmed playing at that origin. Paused current items offer Resume; pending items show a distinct cancellable loading control. Hover/focus replaces listening bars with Pause.

dos: **Do** keep square artwork dominant and the control layer neutral.
**Do** preserve saved component styles, materials, columns, and motion preferences.
**Do** keep cover opening and playback as distinct controls with visible keyboard feedback.
**Do** preserve wall order, scroll, and queue while background data settles.
**Do** state the manual-tag and confirmed-history basis of Dig.
**Do** preserve the fixed Settings header/tabs and single scrolling body.
donts: **Don't** show confirmed-playing decoration for paused, suspended, or pending playback.
**Don't** let volume collide with centered transport at intermediate desktop widths.
**Don't** focus library Search underneath an open album view.
**Don't** promote fixture artwork colors or synthesized sidecar ramps into brand tokens.
**Don't** turn source gaps or untested native/live-provider behavior into certified design claims.
